stem: Which trend has been observed regarding the non-medical use of tranquilizers (benzodiazepines) among secondary school students?

options.text: A sharp decrease in use since the $1980$s
An increasing trend with $20$\% reporting ever using them
A total replacement of alcohol use with benzodiazepines
No reported use among those under the age of $17$

explanation: The lecture points to a concerning rise in the non-medical use of sedatives/tranquilizers in recent years.
rationale: Look for a percentage that represents one-fifth of the surveyed population.

optionExplanations.A: Unlike traditional cigarettes, benzodiazepine misuse has not seen a steady multi-decade decline.
optionExplanations.B: The lecture points to a concerning rise in the non-medical use of sedatives/tranquilizers in recent years.
optionExplanations.C: Alcohol remains a top substance; one has not replaced the other.
optionExplanations.D: The secondary school survey specifically includes students aged $12$ to $17$ who report use.

source.hint: Look for a percentage that represents one-fifth of the surveyed population.
